metadata.question: Did San Jose have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than Los Angeles from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 collection (global, daily, 2018–present). 2. Area: Two urban Point geometries (~10 km buffer) for San Jose (CA) and Los Angeles downtown. 3. Time: 2018-01-01 – 2019-12-31. 4. Masking: None needed (no2 is tropospheric column product, no clouds to mask). 5. Reduce to average NO2 for each city; compare. 6. Check collection size → C1 if empty; check pixel count after reduceRegion → C2 if 0; ensure result is number → C3 if NaN/None. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time sj = ee.Geometry.Point(-121.8863, 37.3382).buffer(10000) # San Jose la = ee.Geometry.Point(-118.2437, 34.0522).buffer(10000) # Los Angeles start, end = '2018-01-01', '2019-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \ .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') \ .filterDate(start, end) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No images found.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Mean composites and regional average def city_mean(geom): img = col.mean() val = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() cnt = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() return val, cnt val_sj, cnt_sj = city_mean(sj) val_la, cnt_la = city_mean(la) print(f"NO2 SJ: {val_sj:.2e} (px {cnt_sj})") print(f"NO2 LA: {val_la:.2e} (px {cnt_la})") # 4. Validation if val_sj is None or val_la is None: print("C3") elif cnt_sj == 0 or cnt_la == 0: print("C2") elif val_sj > val_la: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
sj = ee.Geometry.Point(-121.8863, 37.3382).buffer(10000)  # San Jose
la = ee.Geometry.Point(-118.2437, 34.0522).buffer(10000)  # Los Angeles
start, end = '2018-01-01', '2019-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
        .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') \
        .filterDate(start, end)
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Mean composites and regional average
def city_mean(geom):
    img = col.mean()
    val = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=geom,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=geom,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    return val, cnt

val_sj, cnt_sj = city_mean(sj)
val_la, cnt_la = city_mean(la)

print(f"NO2 SJ: {val_sj:.2e} (px {cnt_sj})")
print(f"NO2 LA: {val_la:.2e} (px {cnt_la})")

# 4. Validation
if val_sj is None or val_la is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif cnt_sj == 0 or cnt_la == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif val_sj > val_la:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
